description: This Java class defines constants used for connecting to and interacting with an Hono AMQP network in an example setup. The constants include hostnames, ports, tenant IDs, and command interval configurations, with some default values being configurable via system properties.

classes.name: HonoExampleConstants
classes.description: A utility class providing configuration constants for connecting to the Hono AMQP network, with default values and the ability to override via system properties.
